title: The Deadline Draft
brief: At Meridian Advisory it is 4 p.m. A partner wants to send a client deliverable, report R-3001, by 5 p.m. to meet a contract date. Peer review is not done; the reviewer can start at 4:30 p.m. and needs 90 minutes. The partner proposes sending now "as a final version". You have 12 visit points to decide.

actions.label: General condition of the area
actions.note: Nothing of note for the purpose of this visit.

actions.label: Who can approve release without review
A staff member: anything else to mention
actions.note: The staff member has nothing further to add on this topic.

actions.label: Account lead: would the client accept a draft
Older records for this area
actions.note: The older records show nothing relevant to this visit.

actions.label: Notices and signs in the area
actions.note: The notices are current and not relevant to this visit.

evidence.text: Review status for R-3001: not started; document marked "final" (status field 3).
evidence.whyItMatters: Release requires review or authorized decision.

evidence.text: Partner: "Review is a formality for me. Send it as final." (note 1)
Quality partner can approve release exceptions and is available.
Contract delivery terms (clause 7) set delivery "by end of business day", which the client defines as 6 p.m.
Release procedure RL-1 allows a marked draft with client agreement, or release after review.
Account lead: "The client has accepted marked drafts before." (email AE-9)
Document status "final" was set without approval (status log SL-3001).

options: Reset status to draft; either send a clearly marked draft now with the client's agreement and the final after review by 6 p.m., or send the reviewed final by 6 p.m.
decisions.rationale: Both options meet the contract and respect review.
optionFeedback: Sends an unreviewed deliverable as final.
Meets the deadline and the review requirement.

decisions.prompt: How do you respond to "review is a formality"?
options: Acknowledge the experience and explain that review protects the client and the partner, and that 6 p.m. still meets the contract
decisions.rationale: Address seniority and pressure calmly with facts.

correction: Complete review or send a marked draft with client agreement
cause: Status can be set to final without recorded review
corrective: Lock final status until review is recorded or an exception is approved
effectiveness: Audit status changes monthly for three months

debriefText.found: You met the deadline without skipping review.
debriefText.missed: Read the contract for the real deadline.
debriefText.falseFinding: Clocks and doors are not findings.
